brief:
A teenage girl was killed in a traffic accident in Sarda, a village north of Ramallah, the Ma'an news agency reported. The incident involved a single vehicle that crashed under circumstances that remained unclear at the time of reporting.

Emergency services responded to the scene following the collision. The identity of the victim and details about the vehicle involved were not immediately disclosed. The fatality adds to the toll of road accidents across the West Bank, where traffic incidents claim lives regularly despite ongoing safety concerns.
title: Girl dies in single-vehicle crash north of Ramallah
